question.text: Roshni Trust is registered on NSE-SSE but has not yet raised funds through ZCZP or any listed instrument. As per Regulation 91E, the AIR for Roshni Trust shall be:

answer.text: Assessed by an empanelled SIA on a reasonable-assurance basis.
Self-certified annual impact report covering the NPO's significant activities and explaining the methodology for determining significance.
Waived entirely until the first listing.
Filed only upon receipt of a SEBI notice.

explanation.text: The Logic: A Social Enterprise / NPO that is registered on the Social Stock Exchange but has not yet raised funds through a listed instrument files a self-certified Annual Impact Report covering the NPO's significant activities and explaining the methodology used to determine which activities are significant. External SIA assessment is reserved for listed projects. The Trap: Treating registration as if it were listing would wrongly trigger external SIA assessment (option A). A complete waiver (C) or a notice-contingent filing (D) both ignore the standing self-certified annual obligation that applies to registered-only entities. Note: The non-raise window for a registered-only NPO is two years, extendable by one additional year with Social Stock Exchange approval per the SEBI Apr 15 2026 circular, so registration alone does not immediately trigger de-registration if funds have not yet been raised.
